children: The content graph is Barkpark's marquee feature — the link web between documents, made visible — and the structural dual of the Indx Retriever Seam.

Wherever a Document carries a Reference Field, the Edge Extractor reads it and the Edge Projector writes a row into the Content Edges Table. That table is the materialised graph: nodes are documents, edges are references. Because it is the dual of the Indx Retriever Seam, the same links that retrieval follows are the ones the graph draws — search and graph share a backbone.

Blast Radius answers "what breaks if I change this document?" by walking edges outward. Graph Traversal powers related-content and dependency queries. A Dangling Reference (a link to a missing target) surfaces as a Phantom Node, while a document nobody links is an Orphan Node — both are quality signals you can see at a glance.

The Graph View is the interactive surface; the Graph Renderer (bp-graph.js) paints it on Canvas2D, driven by a hand-rolled Force Simulation. Making that render match Obsidian's beloved graph is the entire point of this fixture vault — the live checklist lives in Graph Comparison.
